existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copy charge limited to actual cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A reasonable charge may be imposed for copies and for use of agency copying equipment, not exceeding the amount necessary to reimburse the agency for its actual costs directly incident to copying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A reasonable charge may be imposed for providing copies of public records and for the use by any person of agency equipment or equipment of the office of the secretary of the senate or the office of the chief clerk of the house of representatives to copy public records, which charges shall not exceed the amount necessary to reimburse the agency, the office of the secretary of the senate, or the office of the chief clerk of the house of representatives for its actual costs directly incident to such copying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling = actual cost; city fills the operative rate under it. Also requires use of the most reasonable, cost-efficient method available.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to fifteen cents per page for photocopies or printed copies of electronic records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency has not determined its actual per-copy costs under RCW 42.56.070(7).
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fifteen cents per page for photocopies
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Retrieval tool returned the amount verbatim in quotation marks but condensed the surrounding paragraph. Default schedule applies only if actual costs not determined; verify full clause text at RCW 42.56.120(2)(b)(i).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to ten cents per page for public records scanned into an electronic format.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency has not determined actual per-copy costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Ten cents per page for public records scanned
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Amount verbatim; surrounding clause condensed by retrieval tool.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to five cents per each four electronic files or attachments uploaded for electronic delivery.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency has not determined actual per-copy costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Five cents per each four electronic files
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Amount verbatim; surrounding clause condensed by retrieval tool.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Absent a published actual-cost calculation, the agency may charge up to ten cents per gigabyte for transmission of records in an electronic format.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency has not determined actual per-copy costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Ten cents per gigabyte for the transmission
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Amount verbatim; surrounding clause condensed by retrieval tool. Storage media, containers, and postage chargeable at actual cost separately.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may charge a flat fee of up to two dollars for a request as payment for the costs of providing the copies, in lieu of itemized charges.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency elects a flat fee instead of calculating itemized copy costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency may charge a flat fee of up to two dollars for any request
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling of $2 per request; no additional flat fee may be charged on subsequent installments of the same request. Clause condensed by retrieval tool.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may not impose copying charges for access to or downloading of records it routinely posts on its public internet website.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requested records are routinely posted on the agency's public website.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency shall not impose copying charges under this section for access to or downloading of records that the agency routinely posts on its public internet website.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fixed at zero for routinely-posted records unless the requester specifically requests a copy in a different form.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may charge actual copying costs only in accordance with costs it has established and published; it may establish and make available a statement of the actual costs it charges for copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency wishes to charge actual (rather than default-schedule) costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Each agency may establish, maintain, and make available for public inspection and copying a statement of the actual costs that it charges for providing photocopies or electronically produced copies, of public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Precondition (structural step) to charging actual costs instead of the default statutory schedule.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: In determining actual copy costs, an agency may not include staff salaries, benefits, or general administrative or overhead charges unless directly related to the actual cost of copying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency calculates its actual copy costs.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In determining the actual costs for providing copies of public records, an agency may not include staff salaries, benefits, or other general administrative or overhead charges, unless those costs are directly related to the actual cost of copying the public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Bounds the actual-cost calculation; a calculation-method constraint rather than a fillable value.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may impose a customized service charge for a request that requires information-technology expertise to prepare data compilations or provide customized electronic access not used by the agency for other purposes, only after notifying the requester of the charge and the reason it applies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request requires IT expertise for a data compilation or customized electronic access the agency does not use for other purposes.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Agencies may charge for customized services (data compilations, custom electronic access) only when services aren't used internally, after notifying requestors of costs and reasons.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Retrieval tool returned only a summary of 120(3); verbatim operative clause needs confirmation at RCW 42.56.120(3), which also conditions the charge on advance notice, an explanation, and a cost estimate.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The chapter does not authorize giving, selling, or providing access to lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes, and agencies shall not do so unless specifically authorized or directed by law.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request seeks a list of individuals and the purpose appears commercial.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: This chapter shall not be construed as giving authority to any agency, the office of the secretary of the senate, or the office of the chief clerk of the house of representatives to give, sell or provide access to lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes, and agencies, the office of the secretary of the senate, or the office of the chief clerk of the house of representatives shall not do so unless specifically authorized or directed by law.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: 'Commercial purposes' is the definition the software branches on; it is also the sole basis on which purpose may be inquired (WA-0002).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: An agency may require a deposit not exceeding ten percent of the estimated cost of providing copies for a request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency estimates the cost of providing copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: An agency may require a deposit in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the estimated cost of providing copies for a request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling of 10%; city sets the operative deposit under it.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the requester fails to inspect, pay for, or claim an installment of a records request, the agency need not fulfill the balance of the request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: An installment is not claimed, reviewed, or paid for.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: terminal: balance of request not fulfilled when an installment is unclaimed
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Agencies may charge for partial fulfillment installments and needn't complete requests if portions go unclaimed.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Retrieval tool summarized this portion of 120(4); confirm verbatim operative clause at RCW 42.56.120(4).
